payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that AES refers specifically to the phenomenon where smiling faces are estimated to be older than neutral faces in direct age estimations, and it does not encompass the retrospective estimation of smiling faces being perceived as younger.

claims.text: AES refers only to the effect of smiling faces being estimated as older than neutral faces in direct age estimations.
When estimating age retrospectively, smiling faces are perceived as younger than neutral faces.
